extra.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
extra.test_case: Confirm mounting height of H plane on vehicle; if < 750 mm, verify downward RI angles only to 5° and check Table 3 minima within that range.

extra.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
extra.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of reflected light per paragraph 4.2.1; pass if within UN R48 red night-time colour limits.

extra.text: The conformity requirements for the retro-reflective device shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Dimensional/geometric inspection of production samples against approved type; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements

extra.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the retro-reflective device shall be complied with.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed red boundaries

extra.text: In any test of conformity of the retro-reflective device carried out by the manufacturer, equivalent methods may be used with the consent of the Type Approval Authority, provided the manufacturer proves that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Review of equivalence evidence and authority consent for any alternative method

extra.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
extra.test_case: Verify source calibration to CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

extra.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector sample for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C. Pass: the conditioning sequence is completed as specified, ready for the inspection in para. 3.

extra.text: The retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 §1.1: strip removable parts, immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface. Pass: assessed per §1.2/§1.3 (no water on the reflecting surface).

extra.text: The retro-reflector sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 §1.1: immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C. Pass: assessed per §1.2/§1.3.

extra.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied to the retro-reflective device of Class IB or IIIB to verify resistance to water penetration.
extra.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 moisture test (para. 2) and dust exposure test (para. 2.3) on request of manufacturer; pass if both tests' evaluation criteria are met

extra.text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform, with a collector height of 100 mm and an inside diameter of a minimum of 140 mm.
extra.test_case: Collector measurement: rate 2.5 to 4.1 mm/min; collector 100 mm high, ID ≥ 140 mm

extra.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
extra.test_case: Energise rear position, stop and reversing functions at design voltage, 5 min ON / 55 min OFF during water spray

extra.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
extra.test_case: Run 12 h spray with 12 operating cycles

extra.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation and no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection after drain, including tapping and tilting; pass if no standing pool of water

extra.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
extra.test_case: 5 h exposure; agitation 2–15 s every 15 min with settling between

extra.text: The lamp, since the retro-reflective device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
extra.test_case: Remove all removable parts. Expose to saline mist for 24 h, allow 2 h drying, then a further 24 h. Verify the test log shows a total of 50 h.

extra.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
extra.test_case: After the corrosion test and a 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'. Pass if RA is ≥ the Table 9 value and ≤ the Table 10 value.

extra.text: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer) is used, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed according to cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with 102 min dry at a broadband (300 to 400 nm) irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m², a narrowband (340 nm) irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², a black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and a narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
extra.test_case: Monitor the TM2 cycle parameters during exposure; pass if they stay within the stated tolerances under equilibrium.

extra.text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
extra.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): about 5 min after wiping with 70/30 n-heptane/toluol, inspect the surface visually; pass if there are no apparent surface changes (slight surface cracks acceptable).

extra.text: The approval marking arrangement shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements in Annex 10 are given merely as examples.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark against paragraph 3.3. of UN R150; pass if the arrangement complies with paragraph 3.3.

extra.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

extra.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device must face the same way as the "E".
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter "E".

extra.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the class symbol group is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

extra.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
extra.test_case: Inspect the mounting design and fixings of the installed lamp; pass if the lamp cannot be moved out of its correct position or orientation inadvertently (e.g. without tools or deliberate action).

extra.text: For the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
extra.test_case: Install the lamp on the M1 vehicle on a flat bearing plane and measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the bearing plane (e.g. with an inclinometer or 3D measurement). Pass if the deviation from parallel is within ±3°.

extra.text: For the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
extra.test_case: With the lamp fitted to the vehicle, measure the horizontal angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, using a vehicle-coordinate 3D measurement. Check both the left-hand and the mirrored right-hand unit. Pass if the deviation from parallel is within ±3°.

extra.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the rear combination lamp laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
extra.test_case: Review the manufacturer's fitting instructions and inspect the installed lamp against each instruction (mounting points, fasteners, orientation). Pass if every instruction is met.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors of the left- and right-hand rear combination lamps) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
extra.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: measure the lateral position of the exterior geometrical form of the left and right units relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
extra.test_case: Drawing / visual comparison of the left and right units: pass if the exterior forms are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane. Interior structure is excluded from the check.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function on both units: pass if both units meet the same prescribed colour requirements (red for rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector; white for reversing lamp).

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function on the left and right units at the same test points: pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical. Exception: a function approved as a matched pair is assessed as a pair instead.

extra.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of the preceding paragraphs on the installation of the rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
extra.test_case: Inspect the installation on the vehicle against the preceding installation requirements (e.g. symmetry of paired lamps about the longitudinal median plane). Pass if each requirement is met, or any deviation is limited to what the asymmetrical body shape makes unavoidable.

extra.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
extra.test_case: Design review: verify functions sharing the housing/common outer lens are not declared or treated as an interdependent lamp system; pass if not so classified.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the stop lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Activate the stop lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation occurs.

extra.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the reversing lamp is switched ON.
extra.test_case: Activate the reversing lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation occurs.

extra.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear combination lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
extra.test_case: Measure each function's photometry with the other functions switched ON and OFF in all combinations; pass if every resulting state complies with the applicable device regulation requirements (e.g. intensity limits and stop/position intensity ratio).

extra.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear combination lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
extra.test_case: For light sources shared between functions, measure photometry in each function mode; pass if each mode meets the technical provisions for that function.

extra.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear position lamp, stop lamp or retro-reflector if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
extra.test_case: Observer moving within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

extra.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps, together with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp, can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation check: operate the lighting switch and confirm the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) and the rear registration plate lamp. Repeat under each listed exception condition (parking lamps, side-marker flashing with direction indicators, DRL ON, front position lamp substitution per 5.12.1) to confirm that simultaneous switching is not required there. Pass: no independent switching outside the exception conditions.

extra.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the rear position lamp shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
extra.test_case: Applies only if the rear position lamp forms part of an interdependent lamp system. Energise and de-energise the rear position lamp function and observe all light sources of every interdependent lamp. Pass: all light sources switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
extra.test_case: Photometric/colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie inside the white area bounded by y = 0.150 + 0.640x, y = 0.440, x = 0.500, y = 0.382, y = 0.050 + 0.750x and x = 0.310.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

extra.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

extra.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
extra.test_case: Colorimetric check of the light returned by the retro-reflector under standard illumination, measured through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity lies within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

extra.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count the lamps of each function fitted (both handed units) and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specifications of UN R48 for each function; pass if the counts are equal.

extra.text: Any lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector) may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Installation inspection on the M1 vehicle: if any lamp function is mounted on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.; pass if all conditions are fulfilled, or if no lamp is mounted on a movable component.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", where fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation check: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed (stable or natural rest) position other than the normal position of use, and determine the hidden part of the rear position lamp apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

extra.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", where fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation check: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position other than the normal position of use and determine the hidden part of the retro-reflector apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

extra.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps is not hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
extra.test_case: Vehicle check: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface, verify the additional lamps are switched ON and that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements of rear position lamps.

extra.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors is not hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component is not practicable, additional devices satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the retro-reflectors shall be provided for when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
extra.test_case: Vehicle check: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the retro-reflector apparent surface, verify additional retro-reflectors are effective and meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for retro-reflectors.

extra.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps is not hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable and additional lamps are not used, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the presence of a user notice in the vehicle stating that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the vehicle's presence (e.g. warning triangle); pass if notice present.

extra.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp), even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
extra.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle. Each lamp function must be wired and connected to the vehicle harness. Each function must be made to operate by no more than installing a light source and/or a fuse. Fail if any lamp function needs other work to operate, because it is then deemed not present.

extra.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
extra.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp function; verify replacement function is red, of similar main intensity and position to the failed rear position lamp, and that the replacement device (e.g. stop lamp) still performs its original function when activated.

extra.text: During temporary replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
extra.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with fail-safe replacement active; verify the dashboard tell-tale is activated indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

extra.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that the intensity of all these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
extra.test_case: Activate each variable-intensity condition and measure luminous intensity of rear position and stop functions across the range; pass if both vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

extra.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
extra.test_case: Photometric measurement of stop and rear position intensities at multiple points across the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is maintained throughout.

extra.text: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following environmental conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, and contamination of the light emitting surface.
extra.test_case: Review control strategy and measure intensity under each environmental condition input; pass if variation is triggered only by listed conditions and minimum/maximum intensities stay within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulation (e.g. R7/R148).

extra.text: Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1., a decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
extra.test_case: Vehicle-level test varying speed and following-vehicle distance; pass if traffic-related intensity decrease activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and intensity remains within prescribed limits.

extra.text: As long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h, the intensity decrease of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2 already activated under traffic conditions may remain active.
extra.test_case: Activate the decrease below 20 km/h, then accelerate; pass if the decrease is cancelled no later than when speed exceeds 50 km/h.

extra.text: No sharp variation of intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2 shall be observed during transition.
extra.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during each intensity transition; pass if the change is gradual with no observable step or sharp variation.

extra.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition; pass if it does not exceed the voltage at which the device or function was approved, unless the device includes electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only UN R128 light sources.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 12 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 13.5 V + 3 % (13.905 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 6 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 % (6.9525 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

extra.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
extra.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 24 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 28 V + 3 % (28.84 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

extra.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
extra.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp body, verify the terminal voltage limits of paragraph 5.27.2. are still met at the light-source supply.

extra.text: The LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions) does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
extra.test_case: Document check: if the LED module is non-replaceable, verify that the communication sheet of the component type approval states that the LED module is non-replaceable; if not so stated, verify the LED module is replaceable. Pass if non-replaceability is covered by that statement.

extra.text: In case of light-signalling lamps of the rear combination lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Design review: determine whether any light-signalling function incorporates a manufacturer logo. If it does, check for a valid UN R148 type approval that covers the lamp with the logo. Pass if the approval exists or no logo is incorporated.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device shall be optional.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the reversing lamp devices on the M1 vehicle; pass if 1 or 2 are fitted.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
extra.test_case: Measure the height of the illuminating surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if the lower edge is >= 250 mm and the upper edge is <= 1,200 mm.

extra.text: The geometric visibility of the reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per para. 2.10.7: pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° up to 5° down.

extra.text: The geometric visibility of the reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check per para. 2.10.7 with two reversing lamps fitted: pass if each lamp is unobstructed over 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

extra.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the reference axis of the lamp points rearwards.

extra.text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check the R23/R148 component approval requirements; if a failure tell-tale is required, simulate a lamp failure; pass if the tell-tale indicates the failure.

extra.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on M1 category vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

extra.text: The number of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be two.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count S1/S2 stop lamps across the handed pair of rear combination lamps; pass if exactly two.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

extra.text: S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Visual inspection of vehicle: pass if stop lamps are located at the vehicle rear.

extra.text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: pass if unobstructed visibility 15° up and 15° down (or 5° down when mounted below 750 mm).

extra.text: The orientation of the stop lamp shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Inspect installed lamp reference axis: pass if directed rearwards.

extra.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
extra.test_case: Functional test with propulsion system switched off: stop lamp operation may be absent; pass if it functions in all positions where propulsion can operate.

extra.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
extra.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirement; if required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activates.

extra.text: The installation of rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

extra.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
extra.test_case: Check vehicle and approval markings: pass if exactly two lamps (left and right handed units) with valid R7 (02+) or R148 (00+) approval.

extra.text: There shall be no special requirement for the arrangement of the rear position lamps.
extra.test_case: No verification required.

extra.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
extra.test_case: If alternative chosen and rear side-marker fitted: verify unobstructed view over 45° out to 45° in (20° in below H plane if below 750 mm).

extra.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
extra.test_case: If alternative chosen: verify unobstructed view over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if below 750 mm).

extra.text: The orientation of the rear position lamp shall be rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if reference axis points rearwards.

extra.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
extra.test_case: Functional check per para 5.11: rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with front position lamps and registration plate lamp; pass if compliant.

extra.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

extra.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Visual/photometric assessment of any additional retro-reflecting devices or materials: pass if mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices' effectiveness is not impaired.

extra.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
extra.test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps), or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape justifies.

extra.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

extra.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
extra.test_case: Vehicle inspection: reference axis of retro-reflector directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

extra.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (see paragraph 5.10.4. of this Regulation), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
extra.test_case: With the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground and the red functions lit, an observer scans zone 1 between horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the rear position or stop lamp is directly visible to the front within that zone.

extra.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (see paragraph 5.10.4. of this Regulation), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
extra.test_case: Construct the vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through the contact point(s) of the overall-width planes, using the foremost contact point for the forward plane and the rearmost for the rearward plane. Observe the lit red functions from within the zone bounded by these planes and by the 1 m and 2.2 m height limits. Pass if no red light is directly visible to the front.

extra.text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Compare measured distances against individual installation specifications for each function; pass if all within limits.

extra.text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
extra.test_case: Compare measured angles with individual specifications for each function, allowing ±3° per para 5.3.; pass if within limits including allowance.

extra.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
extra.test_case: Functional check against paras 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications (switching, activation conditions); pass if all conform.

extra.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector and their markings shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
extra.test_case: Compare inspected presence, number, colour (red/white), arrangement and category markings with paras 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications; pass if all conform.
